name: format-ruff
description: Format Python and stub files with Ruff on the workspace machine, using the project's Ruff configuration.

command.description: Ruff executable on the workspace machine, for example ./.venv/bin/ruff

lineLength.description: Override the project's preferred line length. Leave empty to use Ruff's configuration.

quoteStyle.description: Override the project's string quote style. Default uses Ruff's configuration.
